item.title: Cameraless cyanotype prints at Nau Bostik
item.description:
On 15 November we ran the free cameraless cyanotype workshop at Nau Bostik. Fifteen places. Fifteen people. None of them had ever made a cyanotype before.

The formula is simple: two iron salts, paper and sunlight. But “simple” doesn’t mean “no surprises”. Every sheet of paper responds differently. November light in Barcelona is not the same as August light. And the objects people bring — leaves, feathers, keys, a magnifying glass, a phone negative printed onto an acetate at the last minute — completely change the result.

item.title: World Pinhole Photography Day 2025
item.description:
On 27 April we are celebrating World Pinhole Photography Day at the Sala Basiana of the Nau Bostik.

The proposal is simple: come, experiment and take photographs with no more structure than each person wants to give it. The AWPCP.org association lends cameras to anyone who does not have one. Some of the results will be developed in the Llumàtics lab.

No plans, no rules and, above all, no lenses.

item.title: Open days at the Nau Bostik
item.description:
On 26 November the Nau Bostik opened its doors. Llumàtics took part with a small exhibition of large format portraits and a simple offer: anyone who wanted one got a portrait taken.

Vintage large format camera, a Sunday morning and a lot of film.

item.title: Halloween 2020 — Bodypaint and analogue photography
item.description:
For Halloween 2020 we combined two things we like: body painting and analogue photography.

Four session options — face or body painting, for one or two people — each with 30 minutes of analogue photographic session included. The sessions took place at the Nau Bostik.

See the photographs →

item.title: Llumàtics moves to the Nau Bostik
item.description:
After three years in the Poble Sec, Llumàtics is moving to a new location.

In a few weeks we expect to have the new premises ready to resume our usual activity: chemical photography, the real thing, inside the Nau Bostik. There, surrounded by a setting and rooms that are second to none, we will go on offering training, large format sessions and a few surprises we are preparing.

item.title: La Fiesta Pinholera Perversa at Nau Bostik
item.description:
The day started at 10:00 in the morning, with Nau Bostik open to everyone.

At La Perversa we held an open day: the darkroom accessible, the studio available, and if you brought your camera and photographic paper, you could develop your own photos from the day. No fuss. Those who wanted to learn, learnt. Those who wanted to watch, watched.

The experimental pinhole workshop was led by Alfonso de Castro with Santi Pladellorens from Analogueworks, who brought along some of his cameras in very different formats for participants to use. Fifteen euros, limited places, and one of the best sessions of the year.
